question: What is the title of the book by Nandan Kamath that won the Sports Book of the Year award in 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Boundary Lab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Boundary Lab** is the title of the book authored by **Nandan Kamath**, which won the prestigious **Sports Book of the Year award in 2024.**
 
• The book explores various aspects of **sports law, governance, and ethics** in the context of modern sports.
 
• It is a significant contribution to the understanding of **legal and regulatory frameworks** in sports, making it highly relevant for those involved in sports administration, athletes, and legal professionals.
 
• **Nandan Kamath** is an eminent sports lawyer and has been actively involved in promoting better governance and legal practices in sports.
 
• The award highlights the importance of literature that bridges the gap between **sports and legal perspectives**, encouraging informed decision-making and ethical conduct in the sports industry.
 
• The book has received acclaim for its in-depth analysis and comprehensive approach, making it a valuable resource for academicians, policymakers, and sports enthusiasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Spirit of Sports**__

 __
 
• The title suggests a focus on the **emotional, cultural, and inspirational aspects of sports**, but it is not authored by Nandan Kamath or related to the Sports Book of the Year award in 2024.
 
• It might represent a thematic exploration of how sports inspire unity, teamwork, and resilience globally.
 
 
 
• **The Winning Mindset**__
 __
 
• This book likely deals with the **psychological aspects of sports**, such as focus, determination, and mental preparation, but it is not authored by Nandan Kamath.
 
• The concept of a "Winning Mindset" is widely discussed in sports psychology and performance enhancement.
 
 
 
• **Playing It My Way**__
 
 
• This book is the **autobiography of Sachin Tendulkar**, the legendary Indian cricketer.
 
• It recounts his **life and career**, but it is unrelated to the Sports Book of the Year award in 2024.
 
• Published in 2014, it became a bestseller and provides insights into the life of one of India's greatest sports icons.
